name: Colombia
_show_top: Only the best N players (by current 1v1) are shown; everyone listed is still checked, so others can climb in.
_clan_prefixes: Clans some players write into the name itself instead of 'TAG | name'. Matching prefixes are moved into the small clan tag. Names written as '[TAG] Name' are handled automatically.
_players: Add "clan": "TAG" to a player to set their clan when it isn't in their name.
